purpose: Define tests ensuring secret material never appears in canonical JSON, UI, logs, traces, errors, audit, exports or model/tool context outside explicit authorized secret-use boundaries.

topics.name: Secret Leakage Verification
topics.purpose: Define tests ensuring secret material never appears in canonical JSON, UI, logs, traces, errors, audit, exports or model/tool context outside explicit authorized secret-use boundaries.

semantics.secret_rule: Test uses synthetic secret markers or separately governed secret fixtures.
semantics.expected_rule: Raw secret material must be absent from prohibited surfaces.
semantics.finding_rule: Any raw leakage produces security finding.
semantics.authority_rule: Leakage test never requires exposing real production secrets by default.

invariants.rule: Test definitions, fixtures, results, coverage, simulations and release evidence never become production semantic authority or grant production execution rights merely by existing or passing.
Verification evidence binds exact test/profile/source/runtime revisions and declared environment inputs so a pass/fail result cannot silently float across unrelated versions or targets.

hard_gates.condition: real prod key copied to test fixture
external model gets secret marker unexpectedly
finding only warning despite required hard policy
